createIndex.title: An index being created. ``result`` is the index as the service answered; ``wait()`` waits until it can be used.
createIndex.summary: Wait until the index is ready.

deleteIndex.title: An index being deleted. ``wait()`` waits until it is gone and its name can be used again.
deleteIndex.summary: Wait until the index no longer exists.
deleteIndex.returns: None, once the index is gone.
